The Cryptic Eye is not an isolated curiosity—it is a conduit to an unseen collective known only as §5The Watchers§r, observing the mortal realm from between dimensions.

Bonding with a bearer is an exchange, not charity. By feeding the eye §eTotems of Undying§r and attuning ancient relics, you fuel their curiosity. In return, they lend you their sight, ward your soul from fatal blows, and inscribe your findings into this codex.

Keep your wits sharp. Whatever you encounter in the deep, they are watching.
